description: How the shop did in one week (Monday to Sunday in the shop's time zone) against the week before: money collected, refunded, paid outside and invoiced; quotes sent and signed; jobs, visits, customers and requests; time logged and expenses.

week_of.description: Any day in the week to read. Default: today in the shop's time zone (this week so far).

name: reports_week

collected_minor.description: Card and bank payments through Doing Work that succeeded in the week, by the day they succeeded (tips included).

expenses_minor.description: Expenses spent in the week, in the shop's currency.

invoiced_minor.description: Invoices issued in the week (not voided), tax included.

jobs_done.description: Jobs that became done in the week and are done now.

minutes_logged.description: Approved and pending time started in the week.

outside_minor.description: Invoices recorded as paid outside Doing Work, by the paid-on date.

quotes_sent.description: Quotes last sent in the week.

quotes_signed_minor.description: Amount in minor units of the currency (cents).

refunded_minor.description: Amount in minor units of the currency (cents).

next_steps.description: Up to 3 useful next steps, best first, in plain words. op names the op to call, when there is one. when is now, later, check, or tell_human. due_at is set for later and check when there is a natural time. A send is tell_human: show the owner the draft, then send only when they say so.
